definitions.explanation: Having the characteristics of a city or large urban area. Used to describe places, lifestyles, or infrastructure associated with city living.
Having a polished, refined, or fashionable quality associated with city culture. Used to describe people's appearance, manners, or sensibilities.

examples.japanese: {都会的|とかいてき}な{街並|まちな}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{再開発|さいかいはつ}→再開発：17066_saikaihatsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{都会的|とかいてき}な⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: The area in front of the station changed to an urban atmosphere through redevelopment.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地方都市|ちほうとし}→地方都市：17442_chihoutoshi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{都会的|とかいてき}な⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧ようになってきた。
examples.english: Even this regional city has become a place where you can live an urban lifestyle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{都会的|とかいてき}な⟦センス→センス：10468_sensu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: He has a sophisticated sense of style.

examples.japanese: {都会的|とかいてき}な⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦カフェ→カフェ：06767_kafe⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}っていた→座る：00757_suwaru⟧。

examples.english: Although raised in the countryside, she acquired a sophisticated bearing.

notes:
A na-adjective formed from ⟦{都会|とかい}→都会：02475_tokai⟧ (city; urban area) + ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧. Has two related senses: one describing the physical or lifestyle characteristics of city areas, and another describing the refined, fashionable sensibility associated with city people.

The second sense (sophisticated) is particularly common as a compliment when describing someone's appearance or manner, implying they are polished and worldly.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {都会的|とかいてき}な⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧: urban/sophisticated atmosphere
- {都会的|とかいてき}な⟦センス→センス：10468_sensu⟧: sophisticated taste
- {都会的|とかいてき}な⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧: urban lifestyle
- {都会的|とかいてき}な⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧: urban-style town
- {都会的|とかいてき}な⟦{暮|く}らし→暮らし：02670_kurashi⟧: city living

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{洗練|せんれん}された→洗練される：22304_senrensareru⟧: refined; polished — focuses purely on sophistication without the city connection
- ⟦おしゃれ→おしゃれ：02515_oshare⟧な: fashionable; stylish — more casual and broadly applicable
- ⟦{田舎|いなか}→田舎：01320_inaka⟧⟦っぽい→っぽい：06781_ppoi⟧: rustic; country-like — the opposite in nuance
